name: The Last Yandere
source:
The Last Yandere is a Yandere-themed Mystery Horror Visual Novel Dating Simulator with an end of the world apocalypse threat. You play the role of a cancer survivor slowly easing his way back into normal slice of life activities. One day, you befriend an overly zealous and bubbly cake shop owner named Kara Gentner. Soon you realize Kara isn't your typical girl.

Is your new friend a lovesick Yandere?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.appsir.thelastyandere]Google Store[/url]]
translation:
最后的Yandere是一款以Yandere为主题的神秘恐怖视觉小说约会模拟器，带有世界末日威胁。你扮演癌症幸存者的角色，慢慢恢复正常的生活活动。有一天，你和一位过于热心、活泼的蛋糕店老板卡拉·根特纳 (Kara Gentner) 成为了朋友。很快你就意识到卡拉不是典型的女孩。

你的新朋友是个相思病狂吗？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.appsir.thelastyandere]Google商店[/url]]
